identity.accountExists: This email already has an account.

goal.title: Where do you want to go?
goal.motivationPlaceholder: In your own words, what motivates you on this path…
goal.motivationShort: At least 20 characters so we can personalize your trail.
goal.yearsRequired: Share your experience so we can calibrate the diagnosis.
goal.cvHint: or click to choose · PDF · up to 5 MB
goal.cvOptional: Optional — we will use it to personalize your trail soon

diagnosis.intro: No right or wrong answers — two fixed rounds. The more concrete, the better AI maps your profile.
diagnosis.updatingMap: AI is updating your competency map.
diagnosis.questionsInRound: {count} question(s) this round · answer all of them to continue
diagnosis.dimMotivationHint: Why this path and alignment with your goal
diagnosis.dimBackgroundHint: Prior domain and habits you bring into tech
diagnosis.dimVelocityHint: How much you practice, how often, and how consistently
diagnosis.dimHandsOnHint: Largest thing you have built, attempted, or shipped
diagnosis.dimConstraintsHint: Hours/week, language, budget, how you study today
diagnosis.diagnosisLead: Adjust strengths, gaps, and priorities before forging your trail. This is the snapshot for today — it recalibrates after each validation.
diagnosis.incomplete: Incomplete onboarding data. Please redo the diagnosis.
diagnosis.confirmFailed: Failed to confirm diagnosis or start the forge.
diagnosis.evidenceBody: Career Forge does not let you mark topics complete without proving understanding in an AI interview.
diagnosis.submitFailed: Could not submit your answers. Please try again.

forge.title: Forging your personalized trail
forge.timelineNote: Live timeline — no graph preview during the stream.
forge.planReady: Plan ready — review the result and continue when you want.
forge.revealLead: Each chapter of your plan appears below. Explore your vertical trail when the reveal finishes.
forge.resumeHint: Single-use · expires in ~7 days. Copy it now — you will not see this link again on this screen.
forge.resumeUnavailable: Resume link unavailable — no forge artifact yet.
forge.endedEarly: The forge ended before building the graph. Try again.

assess.mockSubtitle: 5–7 multiple-choice questions grounded in your study block. Answers are scored immediately and recalibrate the trail.
assess.mockFooter: Mock interview feeds the plan — detected gaps recalibrate the trail
assess.validateTitle: Ready to validate what you learned?
assess.validateSubtitle: AI will interview you before unlocking the next topic. Think as if explaining to a peer.
assess.validateFooter: Evidence-based assessment — checking a box is not enough
assess.enterHint: Enter to continue · Shift+Enter new line
assess.reviewBody: You are close, but not quite there yet.

mentor.empty: Ask about references, validation gaps, or how to practice {title}.

tutor.empty: Ask technical questions about {title}. The tutor answers grounded in key concepts, references, and your gaps.
tutor.failed: Failed to talk to the tutor

roadmap.tutorBlurb: Chapter tutor — technical Q&A grounded in concepts and your gaps.
roadmap.checklistNote: Checking off reading and practice helps track study — optional and does not replace AI validation. Real mastery proof remains the mock interview.
roadmap.clickNode: Click a node to see status, references, and validate mastery.
roadmap.adaptiveTrail: The trail reacted to your performance — review the highlighted node before moving on.

report.title: Learning evidence
report.lead: Mentors see what the learner demonstrated — not guesswork.
report.empty: No validations recorded yet. Ask the learner to validate a topic on the trail.

paywall.body: Your included forge is spent. USD $7/mo continues Career Forge.
paywall.audience: BASE and PSP stay included. This panel is for an external account with no subscription.
paywall.allowlist: Checkout is not live yet. Ask to be added to the pilot billing allowlist.

recovery.savedMany: You have {count} saved forges. Continue where you left off, browse all, or start a new one.
recovery.title: Your forges
recovery.lead: Scan and open a saved roadmap. Rename anytime; share and resume live in the row menu.
recovery.reuse: Reuse your last diagnosis without re-interviewing.
